widgets_values: Inside a glass-walled office hallway bathed in cool fluorescent light, a lone Blue Ranger stands at effortless attention. Sleek cobalt spandex armor hugs every contour, trimmed with silver piping and a bold diamond crest that glints across his chest. A glossy black visor hides his gaze, reflecting workstation monitors flickering beyond the corridor. In his left hand, he plants a matte-black Power Staff to the tiles—a subtle hum of latent energy rippling along its length—while his right fist rests at a ready guard beside a gold-accented Morphin belt buckle. He’s framed by scattered recycling bags, up-ended cardboard, and the faint reflection of a stylized poster on the far glass, injecting a note of mundane disorder into the high-tech scene. Capture a crisp palette of sapphire blues, icy whites, and metallic silvers; balance sterile office lighting with a soft cyan glow from the staff, and add faint speed-line streaks around his silhouette to suggest imminent, morphin-charged motion.
